trap.label: plural
trap.wrong: There is two books on the table.
trap.right: There are two books on the table.
trap.why: O português não marca a concordância ("há dois livros"); em inglês o verbo concorda com o que vem depois.

mcq.q: Short answer: Is there a park? ___

fix.wrong: It is a park near my house.
fix.right: There is a park near my house.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com there are: “Three cats are on the sofa.”
rewrite.answer: There are three cats on the sofa.

rewrite.prompt: Faça pergunta: “There is a bank here.”
Negue com there isn’t: “There is a park here.”
